checks.behavior: Changed accepted source requires repreparation with SOURCE_CHANGED; wrong frozen input digest returns SUBJECT_STALE before run allocation or model generation.
Prepared file contents are read and hashed, not treated as their path string. Changing the actual file makes a later preparation reject SUBJECT_STALE.
Unavailable gateway/tool produces actionable CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE/WORKFLOW_NOT_READY without dispatch. A declared required evidence port without a producer is rejected by compilation.
Unknown schema/graph semantics and unsupported human declarations fail READINESS_UNSUPPORTED/WORKFLOW_NOT_READY with correction; they do not weaken the accepted schema.
A required choice consumed by a later step blocks public start as unresolved/INPUT_REQUIRED before any model call, owned task, durable receipt, log or early output.
Declared upstream output is ready before its producer executes and retains exact producer step/port. A declared human response is classified separately; only actual preparation inputs are frozen.
Two structured human barriers wait and resume the same run/log. Two retained typed answers feed only their eligible later steps; exact retry after consumption performs no model replay.
Invalid frozen schema, wrong source/scope/subject and malformed route answers create no response, alter no checkpoint, and dispatch no additional step.
Changed/unconsumed v3 subject cannot restore continuation. Changed actual artifact returns actionable 409 SUBJECT_STALE without another model call.
Lost-ack retry returns the original immutable response before/after consumption. Concurrent response/consume and duplicate start each allocate or dispatch once; changed payload conflicts.
Actual controlled ASGI SSE and legacy NDJSON disconnect leave the backend owner live; releasing the fake model finishes the same run with one model call.
Recreated owner reattaches a terminal run without model work; API recreation while interrupted reports reconciliation_required without silently restarting the retained receipt.

Canonical two-review fixture resumes its original v2 run and true final step. Separate current production owner lookup rereads both actual persisted v2 records unchanged as approvals, without decision/dispatch/resume.

Interrupted consumed response segments and stale/uncertain approvals do not execute later work or alter the original log. Unconfirmed external cancellation stays cancellation_unconfirmed and never becomes completed; submission occurs once.

Cancellation requested and actual provider-status cancelled are separate events. Local cancellation retains earlier completed output; disconnecting its observer does not abandon the durable cancellation command or replay it.

Invalid finite observation budgets fail before submission/readiness. A qualified multihour external budget remains outside bounded model decisions, while one stalled status call stays short and triggers explicit cancellation without resubmission.

A model asking an undeclared runtime question, or returning an invalid outcome envelope, fails with an owning-block diagnostic. No new waiting interaction/respond authority appears; retry is OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and does not call the model again.

limits: 81 cases in 35 existing test functions exercise controlled current backend/compiler/transport fixtures, with fake model/provider behavior; they are not another live engineering/MCP/browser or physical demonstration.
Backend reopening is in-process owner/API recreation and persisted state inspection, not arbitrary OS crash or distributed lease guarantee.
Provider cancellation confirms only the configured reported outcome, never a physical stop; unknown outcomes and mandatory engineering reviews stay held.
Broader contract sections, remaining implementation-task signoff, independent common-view start, stricter printed first-stage and final post-trace installed packaging remain open.
